Primary use of a bed: Sleeping.

Interface Design for Music Streaming Service

1. Core Principles
- Audio-centric: Visuals support, not distract from, the listening experience.
- Minimalistic aesthetic: Clean lines, ample whitespace, limited color palette (e.g., dark mode default with accent colors for active states).
- Accessibility: High contrast ratios, scalable text, screen reader compatibility, keyboard navigation, and clear focus indicators.

2. Main Navigation Structure
- Bottom Navigation Bar (Mobile) / Left Sidebar (Desktop):
  - Home (Discover/Recommended)
  - Library (Playlists, Albums, Artists)
  - Search
  - Now Playing (Persistent mini-player that expands)

3. Key Features & Interface Elements

A. Playlist Creation
- Access: From any song/album/artist view via "..." menu or "Add to Playlist" button.
- Interface:
  - Modal or slide-up panel for naming the playlist.
  - Option to set cover image (auto-generated from first track or user upload).
  - Drag-and-drop reordering in playlist view.
  - Accessibility: Clear labels, keyboard shortcuts (e.g., Ctrl+N for new playlist).

B. Radio Stations
- Access: From artist/album/song view via "Start Radio" button.
- Interface:
  - Visual representation: Waveform or abstract audio visualization.
  - Station name displayed prominently.
  - Controls: Pause, Skip, Like/Dislike (to refine station).
  - Accessibility: ARIA labels for controls, clear status announcements.

C. Social Sharing
- Access: From "..." menu on any track/playlist/album.
- Interface:
  - Share sheet/modal with icons for major platforms (Spotify, Apple Music, Twitter, Facebook, Copy Link).
  - Preview card: Album art, title, artist, and a short description.
  - Accessibility: Descriptive alt text for shared images, keyboard-navigable share options.

4. Now Playing View
- Central focus: Large album art, track title, artist name.
- Controls: Play/Pause, Previous, Next, Shuffle, Repeat.
- Progress bar: Clickable and draggable, with time display.
- Expandable: Swipe up or click to reveal lyrics, queue, and related artists.
- Accessibility: VoiceOver/TalkBack support, haptic feedback options, high-contrast mode toggle.
